arabic_text: وَ أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّرُ لِذَلِكَ لَا يُغَالَبُ أَمْرُكَ وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
transliteration: wa anta almuqaddiru lidthalik lā yughālabu amruka wa laa yujāwizu al-mahtūmu min tadbīrika
english_text: But Thou art the Ordainer of that - Thy command is not overcome, the inevitable in Thy governing is not overstepped!

arabic_text: كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَ أَنَّى شِئْتَ
transliteration: kayfa shi'ta wa anna shi'ta
english_text: However Thou willest and whenever Thou willest!

arabic_text: وَ لِمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
transliteration: wa lima anta a'lamu bihi ghayru muttahamin ʿala khalqik wa la li-iradatik
english_text: In that which Thou knowest best, Thou art not accused for Thy creation or Thy will!

arabic_text: حَتَّى عَادَ صِفْوَتُكَ وَ خُلَفَاؤُكَ مَغْلُوبِينَ مَقْهُورِينَ مُبْتَزِّينَ
transliteration: ḥattá ʿāda ṣifwatuka wa khulafāʾuka maghloobiy-na maqhoo-ree-na mubtaz-zeen-a
english_text: Then Thy selected friends, Thy vicegerents, were overcome, vanquished, forcibly stripped;

arabic_text: يَرَوْنَ حُكْمَكَ مُبَدَّلًا وَ كِتَابَكَ مَنْبُوذاً ، وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ وَ سُنَنَ نَبِيِّكَ مَتْرُوكَةً
transliteration: yarawn ḥukmaka mubaddalan wa kitābaka manbūẓan wa fara'idaka muḥarrafaṭan ʿan jihāti ash-rāʿik wa sunna nabiyika matruukah
english_text: they see Thy decree replaced, Thy Book discarded, Thy obligations distorted from the aims of Thy laws, and the Sunna of Thy Prophet abandoned!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ وَ مَنْ رَضِيَ بِفِعَالِهِمْ وَ أَشْيَاعَهُمْ وَ أَتْبَاعَهُمْ
transliteration: allāhumma al-ʿan ʾaʿdāʾahum min al-ʾawwalīna wa al-ʾākhirīn wa man raḍiya bifiaʿalihim wa ashyaʾahum wa atbaʿahum
english_text: O God, curse their enemies among those of old and the later folk, and all those pleased with their acts, and their adherents and followers!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ كَصَلَوَاتِكَ وَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ تَحِيَّاتِكَ عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin ʾinnaka ḥamīdun majīdun ka ṣalāwatika wa barakātika wa taḥiyyātik ʿalā ʾaṣfīyāʾika ibrāhīma wa āli ibrāhīma
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad (surely Thou art All-laudable, All-glorious) like Thy blessing, benedictions, and salutations upon Thy chosen Abraham and the people of Abraham!

arabic_text: وَ عَجِّلِ الْفَرَجَ وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
transliteration: wa ʿajjil al-faraj wa ar-roḥa wa an-nuṣrata wa at-tamkīna wa at-ta'yyīda lahum
english_text: And hasten for them relief, ease, help, strengthening,and confirmation!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ التَّوْحِيدِ وَ الْإِيمَانِ بِكَ وَ التَّصْدِيقِ بِرَسُولِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma wajʿalnī.. min ahlī ʾattawḥīd wa al-īmāni bika wa at-taṣdīqi bi rasūlika
english_text: O God, and make me one of the people who profess Thy Unity, have faith in Thee, and attest to Thy Messenger

arabic_text: وَ الْأَئِمَّةِ الَّذِينَ حَتَمْتَ طَاعَتَهُمْ مِمَّنْ يَجْرِي ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
transliteration: wa al-a'immati alladhina hattamta ta'atahum mimman yajrī dhalika bihi wa ʿalá yadayhi
english_text: and the Imams toward whom Thou hast enjoined obedience, and one of those through whom and at whose hands this takes place!

arabic_text: آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
transliteration: ʾāmīn rabbi al-ʿālamīn
english_text: Amen, Lord of the worlds!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ ، وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ وَ لا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ وَ لَا يُنْجِينِي مِنْكَ
transliteration: allāhumma laysa yaruddu ghaḍabaka illā ḥilmuka , wa lā yaruddu sakhatuka illā 'afwuka wa lā yujīru min ʿiqābika illā raḥmatuka wa lā yunjinī minka
english_text: O God, nothing repels Thy wrath but Thy clemency, nothing repels Thy displeasure but Thy pardon, nothing grants sanctuary from Thy punishment but Thy mercy, and nothing will deliver me from Thee

arabic_text: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجاً بِالْقُدْرَةِالَّتِي بِهَا تُحْيِي أَمْوَاتَ الْعِبَادِ
transliteration: illā at-taḍarruʿu ʾilayka wa bayna yadayka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa hab lana ya ilahi min ladunka farajan bi al-qudrah al-lati biha tuhyi amwat al-'ibad
english_text: except pleading to Thee before Thee, so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and give us on Thy part, my God, relief by means of the power through which Thou bringest the dead servants to life

arabic_text: وَ بِهَا تَنْشُرُ مَيْتَ الْبِلَادِ
transliteration: wa bihā tanshuru maytal bilād
english_text: and revivest the dead lands.

arabic_text: . وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِي يَا إِلَهِي غَمّاً حَتَّى تَسْتَجِيبَ لِي وَ تُعَرِّفَنِي الْإِجَابَةَ فِي دُعَائِي
transliteration: wa lā tuhliknī yā ilāhī ghamman ḥattā tastajība lī wa tuʿarrafanī al-ijābata fī duʿāʾī
english_text: Destroy me not through gloom, my God, before Thou respondest to me and givest me the knowledge of Thy response to my supplication!

arabic_text: وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
transliteration: wa adhqnī ṭaʿmal-ʿāfiya ilā muntaḥā ajalī
english_text: Let me taste the flavour of well-being to the end of my term!

arabic_text: وَ لَا تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوِّي وَ لَا تُمَكِّنْهُ مِنْ عُنُقِي وَ لَا تُسَلِّطْهُ عَلَيَّ
transliteration: wa lā tushmit biy ʿaduwwi wa lā tumakkinnhu min ʿunuqī wa lā tusallithu ʿalayya
english_text: And let not my enemy gloat over me, place not my neck in his power, and give him not authority over me!

arabic_text: إِلَهِي إِنْ رَفَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَضَعُنِي
transliteration: ilāhī in rafaʿtanī faman dhā al-ladhī yaḍaʿunī
english_text: My God, if Thou raisest me up, who is there to push me down?

arabic_text: وَ إِنْ وَضَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَرْفَعُنِي
transliteration: wa in wadaʿtanī faman dha alladhi yarfa`uni
english_text: If Thou pushest me down, who is there to raise me up?

arabic_text: وَ إِنْ أَكْرَمْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُهِينُنِي
transliteration: wa in akramtani faman dhā alladhī yuhīnunī
english_text: If Thou honourest me, who is there to humiliate me?

arabic_text: وَ إِنْ أَهَنْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُكْرِمُنِي
transliteration: wa in ahantanī faman dhā alladhī yukrimunī
english_text: If Thou humiliatest me, who is there to honour me?

arabic_text: وَ إِنْ عَذَّبْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَرْحَمُنِي
transliteration: wa in ʿaẓẓabtanī faman dhā alladhī yarhamunī
english_text: If Thou chastisest me, who is there to have mercy upon me?

arabic_text: وَ إِنْ أَهْلَكْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ أَوْ يَسْأَلُكَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِ
transliteration: wa in ahlaktani man dhā alladhī yaʿriḍu laka fī ʿabdika? ʾaw yasʾalu-ka ʿan ʾamri-hi
english_text: If Thou destroyest me, who is there to stand up for Thy servant against Thee or ask Thee about his affair?

arabic_text: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ وَ لَا فِي نَقِمَتِكَ عَجَلَةٌ
transliteration: wa qad 'alimtu annahu laysa fi hukmika dhulm wa lā fī naqimati-ka ʿajalah
english_text: But I know that there is no wrong in Thy decree and no hurry in Thy vengeance.

arabic_text: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
transliteration: wa innama yaʿjalu man yakhafu al-fawt wa inna ma yah'taju ila al-thulmi al-dha'if
english_text: He alone hurries who fears to miss, and only the weak needs to wrong.

arabic_text: وَ قَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا إِلَهِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
transliteration: wa qad taʿālayta yā ilāhī ʿan dhalika ʿuluwwan kabeeran
english_text: But Thou art exalted, my God, high indeed above all that!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ لَا تَجْعَلْنِي لِلْبَلَاءِ غَرَضاً ، وَ لَا لِنَقِمَتِكَ نَصَباً وَ مَهِّلْنِي، وَ نَفِّسْنِي
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa lā tajʿalnī lil-balāʾi gharadhan wa lā li-naqimati-ka naṣaban wa mahhilnī, wa naffisnī
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, make me not the target of affliction nor the object of Thy vengeance, respite me, comfort me,

arabic_text: وَ أَقِلْنِي عَثْرَتِي وَ لَا تَبْتَلِيَنِّي بِبَلَاءٍ عَلَى أَثَرِ بَلَاءٍ فَقَدْ تَرَى ضَعْفِي
transliteration: wa aqilni ʿathrati wa lā tabtalīnī bi-balā'in ʿalā athari balāʾin fa qad tarā ḍaʿfī
english_text: release me from my stumble, and afflict me not with an affliction in the wake of an affliction, for Thou hast seen my frailty,

arabic_text: وَ قِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي وَ تَضَرُّعِي إِلَيْكَ
transliteration: wa qillata ḥīlatī wa taḍarruʿī ilayka
english_text: the paucity of my stratagems, and my pleading to Thee!

arabic_text: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِذْنِي.
transliteration: 'a'ūdhu bi-ka allāhumma al-yawma min ghaḍabika faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī wa aʿiẓnī
english_text: I seek refuge in Thee today, my God, from Thy wrath, so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me refuge!
